rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a thunderstorm, especially in weather reports and forecasts.

example.english: The observatory predicts a thunderstorm tomorrow, so remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.
example.traditional: 天文台預測聽日有雷暴，大家出門口記得帶遮。
example.jyutping: tin1 man4 toi4 jyu6 cak1 ting1 jat6 jau5 leoi4 bou6 daai6 gaa1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing rain accompanied by thunder rather than the storm as a weather system.

example.english: A thunderstorm is happening now, so don't play football outside.
example.traditional: 而家落緊雷雨，唔好喺出面踢波。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 lok6 gan2 leoi4 jyu5 m4 hou2 hai2 ceot1 min6 tek3 bo1
